content.stem: 在为组织选择反金融犯罪(AFC)工具时,最重要的考虑因素是该工具是否:

options.A: 与现有系统和流程无缝集成.
options.C: 自动化所有监管报告要求.

content.stem_en: When selecting an anti-financial crime (AFC) tool for an organization, the most important factor to consider is whether the tool:

options_en.A: Integrates seamlessly with existing systems and processes.
options_en.D: Replaces manual compliance training for employees.
